dialogs.description: This swifttunnel integration is unoffcial. Although we used the default SDK forked it synced with the latest app to be used with crush. Please dont complain Swifttunnel with us.

enableTunnelingCard.title: Activa el túnel
enableTunnelingCard.description: Activa el túnel per encaminar Roblox a través de la VPN

disconnectWhenRobloxIsClosed.title: Disconnect on Roblox is closed
disconnectWhenRobloxIsClosed.description: Option to kill SwiftTunnel when roblox is closed

multipleAssetsThoughRelays.title: Route assets to multiple relays
multipleAssetsThoughRelays.description: This route assets to multiple relays, improving assets load speed. Might break authenthication, launch from web to avoid login.

enableRoutingCard.title: Activa l'encaminament de Roblox
enableRoutingCard.description: Encamina totes les sol·licituds API de Roblox a través de la VPN. Això pot servir per evitar jocs bloquejats en alguns països.

enableCountryBanCard.title: Evita el bloqueig per país
enableCountryBanCard.description: Encamina tot el tràfic d'inici de Roblox a través del relé i activa l'evasiò DPI. Utilitzeu-ho si Roblox està bloquejat al vostre país. Implica l'encaminament de Roblox.

enablePartialCountryBanCard.title: Bypass Partial Ban
enablePartialCountryBanCard.description: Relays only Roblox control-plane traffic so blocked games appear and join. Gameplay UDP stays direct so you keep your real in-game ping. Use this if only specific games are blocked in your country (e.g. Vietnam).

activityWatcherCard.title: Observador d'Activitat
activityWatcherCard.description: Observa la teva activitat a Roblox. Algunes funcions requereixen que estigui activat.

serverNotifierCard.title: Notificador d'ubicació del servidor
serverNotifierCard.description: Get notified when the client connects to a server.

processPriorityCard.title: Prioritat del procés
processPriorityCard.description: EXTREMADAMENT EXPERIMENTAL. Canvia la prioritat del procés de Roblox. Pot millorar el rendiment.

optimizerCard.title: Enable optimizer
optimizerCard.description: Optimize Roblox by limiting resource its can use. Inprised by how 8damon/TASX-Roblox-Optimizer on github work. Anything nowdays are all rewrite in rust.

disableFullscreenoptimizationCard.title: Desactivar optimització de pantalla completa
